name: Cashback SBI Card
rewardNotes: 5% on online spends and 1% offline, each capped at ₹2,000 per statement. No cashback on utilities, insurance, fuel, rent, wallets, education, jewellery or railways. Travel is modelled at 1% because offline bookings earn only that.

name: Axis Bank ACE Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5% on utility bills, DTH and mobile recharges paid through Google Pay; 4% on Swiggy, Zomato and Ola; the two share a ₹500 cap per statement. 1.5% on everything else. No cashback on fuel, rent, wallets, insurance, education, gold or utilities paid outside Google Pay.

name: Airtel Axis Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10% back on Zomato (up to ₹200 a month, min order ₹499). 25% on Airtel bills and 10% on utilities via the Airtel Thanks app are capped relative to your base cashback, so PERQ models bills at the 1% base. 1% on other spends.

name: Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5% on Flipkart and Cleartrip and 7.5% on Myntra, each capped at ₹4,000 per quarter (modelled as ₹1,333 a month on shopping). 4% on preferred merchants including Swiggy and Uber, 1% elsewhere. Utilities modelled at 0% (Axis excludes them from cashback on most cards). No cashback on fuel.

name: HDFC Bank Millennia Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5% CashPoints on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, Uber and 4 more (cap 1,000/month), 1% elsewhere (cap 1,000/month); 1 CashPoint = ₹1. ₹1,000 voucher for each quarter with ₹1 lakh spend, modelled as ₹4,000 at ₹4 lakh a year. Welcome 1,000 CashPoints only when the joining fee is paid. Nothing on fuel, rent, wallets, EMI.

name: Swiggy HDFC Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10% on the Swiggy app (food, Instamart, Dineout; min ₹249) up to ₹1,500 a cycle; 5% on online shopping merchants like Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra up to ₹1,500; 1% elsewhere up to ₹500. Instamart and Dineout are modelled at 1% because groceries and dining mostly happen elsewhere. Fee from HDFC MITC (Oct 2026).

name: Tata Neu Plus HDFC Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 2% NeuCoins on Tata brands (BigBasket, Croma, Tata CLiQ…), 1% elsewhere; 1 NeuCoin = ₹1 on Tata Neu. UPI earns 0.25% (another 0.75% via the Tata Neu UPI ID), capped at 500 a month. Grocery NeuCoins capped at 1,000 a month. Nothing on fuel, rent, wallets, government. Tata-brand 2% isn't modelled because those brands aren't the main platforms in any category.

name: SimplyCLICK SBI Card
rewardNotes: 10X points on partners (Amazon, Myntra, Swiggy, Cleartrip, BookMyShow…), 5X on other online spends (capped at 10,000 points a month), 1 point per ₹100 offline; 4 points = ₹1. ₹2,000 e-vouchers at ₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh of online spends are not modelled (online-only). Welcome Amazon gift card ₹500.

name: IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 4% back at IOCL pumps on up to ₹5,000 a month; 1% on online shopping on up to ₹5,000 a month; 1 EDGE point per ₹100 elsewhere (1 point = ₹0.20). Fuel rate assumes you fill up at IndianOil.

name: HSBC Live+ Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10% cashback on dining, food delivery, groceries, shopping and utilities, up to ₹1,200 a month in total; 1.5% unlimited on most other spends. Shopping is modelled at 1.5% because the 10% applies only to the merchant types in HSBC's footnote.

name: SimplySAVE SBI Card
rewardNotes: 10 points per ₹150 on dining, movies, departmental stores and groceries; 1 point per ₹150 elsewhere; 4 points = ₹1. 2,000 bonus points (₹500) for ₹2,000 spent in the first 60 days.

name: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5% on Amazon for Prime members, 3% otherwise (PERQ uses 3%: Prime is a paid membership). 2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants, 1% on other spends, as Amazon Pay balance. Lifetime free.

name: IDFC FIRST Millennia Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10X points on dining, travel, international and birthday spends; 3X on most others; 1X on utilities, insurance, railways and FASTag. 1X = 1 point per ₹200, 1 point = ₹0.25 (₹99 + GST per redemption). Nothing on fuel or EMI. Lifetime free.

name: IDFC FIRST Classic Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10X points on dining, travel and international; 3X on eligible spends including UPI; 1X on utilities and insurance. 1X = 1 point per ₹200, 1 point = ₹0.25. Lifetime free.

name: IDFC FIRST Select Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10X points on dining, travel and international; 3X on UPI and other eligible spends; 1X on utilities. 1X = 1 point per ₹200, 1 point = ₹0.25. Lifetime free, with lounge access.

name: Axis Bank Neo Credit Card
rewardNotes: 1 EDGE point per ₹200 (1 point = ₹0.20). The card's value is in merchant offers PERQ doesn't count: ₹120 off Zomato orders over ₹499, 5% off Paytm recharges, 10% off BookMyShow. ₹250 a year, lifetime free through select channels.

name: ICICI Bank Platinum Chip Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: ICICI publishes 2 points per ₹100 (1 on utilities and insurance) but not what a point is worth in rupees, so PERQ can't compute its value. Lifetime free, age 21–65.

name: Scapia Federal Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: the bank and Scapia pages block automated reading. Advertised: 10% Scapia Coins on everyday spends, 5% on RuPay UPI over ₹500, 5 coins = ₹1, coins only redeemable on Scapia travel bookings.

name: HSBC Visa Platinum Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: HSBC publishes 2 points per ₹150 (up to 6x on travel) but no rupee value per point. Lifetime free.

name: AU Bank LIT Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: au.bank.in blocks automated reading. A customisable card: you pay for feature packs (cashback, rewards) that PERQ can't model without the bank's current terms.

name: HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card
rewardNotes: 3% CashPoints on groceries, supermarkets, dining and PayZapp; 2% on utilities; 1% elsewhere; each capped at 500 CashPoints a month. 1 CashPoint = ₹0.25 against your statement, so the real value is 0.75% / 0.5% / 0.25%. Works on UPI. ₹99 fee, waived at ₹25,000 a year.

name: Kiwi YES Bank RuPay Credit Card
rewardNotes: 1.5% cashback on every UPI scan-and-pay (5% needs the paid Kiwi Neon plan, not modelled). Virtual RuPay card that lives in the Kiwi UPI app. Lifetime free. Source is the official Kiwi card-program page (issuer: YES Bank).

name: HSBC RuPay Cashback Credit Card
rewardNotes: 10% cashback on dining, food delivery and groceries, up to ₹400 a month; 1% on all other eligible spends including UPI.

name: ICICI Bank Coral RuPay Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: earns 2 points per ₹100 domestically including UPI, but ICICI doesn't publish a rupee value per point. ₹500 + GST fee. Age 21–65.

name: HSBC RuPay Platinum Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: earns points on UPI, but HSBC doesn't publish a rupee value per point on the page.

name: Jupiter Edge CSB Bank RuPay Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: the program page renders entirely in script, so the current reward terms couldn't be read.

name: IDFC FIRST WOW! Credit Card
rewardNotes: Backed by an IDFC FIRST fixed deposit of at least ₹20,000; no income proof or credit history needed. 4X points on online, offline and international spends, 1X on utilities and insurance (1X = 1 point per ₹200, 1 point = ₹0.25). Lifetime free.

name: IDFC FIRST EA₹N Credit Card
rewardNotes: Virtual RuPay card against an FD of ₹5,000 or more. 1% cashback on UPI through the IDFC FIRST app, 0.5% through other UPI apps and on online spends (PERQ uses 0.5%). Joining fee is ₹0 under a limited-period offer; ₹499 otherwise, waived at ₹1 lakh a year.

name: Axis Bank Insta Easy Credit Card
rewardNotes: Against an Axis FD of at least ₹15,000. 4 EDGE points per ₹200 (1 point = ₹0.20). No joining or annual fee.

name: SimplySAVE Advantage SBI Card (FD-backed)
rewardNotes: The secured variant of SimplySAVE (same page): same earn of 10 points per ₹150 on dining, movies, departmental stores and groceries. SBI doesn't publish the minimum FD on the page.

name: Kotak 811 #DreamDifferent Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED reward rate: the page confirms an FD of ₹10,000 (181+ days), ₹500 joining fee incl. GST from 1 Sep 2026, no annual fee and age 18+, but not the current reward rate.

name: OneCard
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: the program page confirms no joining, annual or redemption fees and 5X points on your top two categories, plus an FD-backed version from ₹5,000, but not the base earn rate or point value.

name: HDFC Bank Regalia Gold Credit Card
rewardNotes: From 15 May 2026: 5 points per ₹200 on eligible spends. Valued at ₹0.20 a point (statement credit); worth more on SmartBuy flights and hotels. Quarterly and annual voucher milestones weren't restated in the 2026 change notice, so they aren't counted. Lounge: 3 domestic visits a quarter after ₹60,000 the previous quarter. Fee from HDFC MITC (Oct 2026).

name: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC Bank Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5% NeuCoins on Tata brands (BigBasket, Croma, Air India, Taj…), 1.5% elsewhere including groceries, insurance and utilities (each capped at 2,000 a month). UPI: 0.5% via any app (+1% via the Tata Neu UPI ID), capped at 500 a month. 1 NeuCoin = ₹1 on Tata Neu. Nothing on fuel, rent, wallets.

name: BPCL SBI Card OCTANE
rewardNotes: 25 points per ₹100 at BPCL pumps (6.25%, plus 1% surcharge waiver) up to 2,500 points a cycle; 10 points per ₹100 on dining, departmental stores, groceries and movies up to 7,500 a month; 1 point per ₹100 elsewhere; 4 points = ₹1. Welcome 6,000 points (₹1,500) on paying the annual fee. Fuel rate assumes BPCL pumps.

name: SBI Card PRIME
rewardNotes: 10 points per ₹100 on dining, groceries, departmental stores and movies; 2 per ₹100 elsewhere except fuel; 4 points = ₹1. ₹1,000 Pizza Hut voucher per quarter with ₹50,000 spend (modelled as ₹4,000 at ₹2 lakh a year) and ₹7,000 voucher at ₹5 lakh. Welcome ₹3,000 voucher.

name: Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card
rewardNotes: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on direct airline, hotel and Travel EDGE spends; 2 per ₹100 elsewhere; Axis states 1 EDGE Mile = ₹1. Milestones 2,500 miles at ₹3 lakh, +2,500 at ₹7.5 lakh, +5,000 at ₹15 lakh. No miles on utilities, telecom, fuel, insurance, wallets. No spend-based fee waiver.

name: SBI Card ELITE
rewardNotes: 5X (10 points per ₹100) on dining, departmental stores and groceries; 2 per ₹100 elsewhere except fuel; 4 points = ₹1. Bonus points worth ₹2,500 at ₹3 lakh and ₹4 lakh, ₹3,750 at ₹5 lakh and ₹8 lakh. Welcome ₹5,000 voucher. Fee waived at ₹10 lakh.

name: HSBC TravelOne Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: 4 points per ₹100 on flights, travel and foreign currency, 2 elsewhere, but points convert to airline/hotel partners with no stated rupee value. Needs ₹6 lakh a year (salaried) or ₹12 lakh (self-employed).

name: American Express Membership Rewards Credit Card
rewardNotes: UNVERIFIED: Amex doesn't publish a rupee value for Membership Rewards points. 1,000 bonus points for ₹20,000 a month; none on fuel, insurance or utilities. Needs ₹4.5 lakh a year salaried or ₹6 lakh self-employed.
